schedule_basis: receipt-driven conditions only; no fixed completion promise

requires: all four packet responses received as non-placeholder signed payloads
fresh S3 trust-root and attestation receipt
certificate/revocation/trusted-time evidence
candidate/source/four-axis/G2 bindings
independent witness and channel ack
stages.failure_transition: typed_absence_or_fail_closed:no_T0_credit; return to responsible packet; parent remains open

requires: T0 receipt digest and request/idempotency binding verified
independent reviewer confirms role separation
canonical preimage and attestation digest equality
freshness/revocation/replay still valid
HEAD/source/environment hashes unchanged or explicitly rebound
stages.failure_transition: terminal_deferred_or_fail_closed:refresh responsible receipt; unchanged inputs prohibit new AD or repeated acceptance

requires: authority_recheck pass receipt
declared source/G2 mapping accepted for scope
no foreign, stale, duplicate or conflicting layer/axis bindings
stages.failure_transition: no_T1_credit; reject and return to source/authority packet

requires: T1 pass receipt
candidate-bound reproducible environment/import/package closure
binary signatures/origin/build/SBOM/license closure
independent review pass
T2 receipt
all upstream packet digests and hashes collected
cross-package candidate ID, source revision/version and four-axis equality
aggregate receipt records every input, owner, verifier and failure state
stages.failure_transition: aggregate_fail_closed; preserve partial receipts and reopen only the failing packet

requires: aggregate receipt accepted by parent architecture owner
formal UP2-00 contract and its independent review pass
no unresolved typed absence on required inputs
UP2-00 receipt
UP1-04B contract-specific inputs and independent verification
source/environment/authority digests still bind the same candidate
stages.failure_transition: UP1-04B_deferred_or_rejected; retain all raw evidence and do not infer completion

requires: UP1-04B receipt
UP1-04 contract and required execution evidence
formal acceptance checks pass under frozen inputs
UP1-04 receipt
UP2-01 contract and independent review
all preceding receipts, exact hashes and failure records retained
stages.failure_transition: UP2-01_deferred_or_rejected; no final-chain or parent credit

ordering: T0 -> authority_recheck -> T1 -> T2 -> aggregate -> UP2-00 -> UP1-04B -> UP1-04 -> UP2-01; no stage may be skipped, collapsed or inferred from local preparation
blocking_state: fresh S3 trust root, external witness, authority ack, signed source/G2 mapping and candidate-bound environment remain typed_absent until real receipts exist
